x: Representing Surrey in this latter meeting Cliff Brooks placed 2nd over the 400m hurdles in 56.0 and Ernie Obeng again had the beating of Danny Laing but was in turn beaten by the Army's S.Hall - both recorded 10.8 for the 100m.
Tipton must have been hopeful of narrowing the gap and maybe even doing a "2001" on us on the last stage as they now turned out Stuart Hall, a sub 50 ten miler, and still had Nigel Stirk to come.
